headline: Georgia Power, Department of Energy and elected officials celebrate the future of energy production at Plant Bowen
summary: Since bringing the first unit online in 1971, Plant Bowen has been an essential piece of Georgia Power's diverse generation mix, providing reliable energy for the state as it has grown over the decades, and it has become one of the most advanced coal-fired power plants in the world.
